text: Compared 12 ways to drive the yolo-twice UI and 4 session-data sources for a scripted live demo in the pitch's slide 09, and wrote the findings to ~/.claude/plans/pasted-content-id-bba5-we-are-transient-nautilus.md. The recommendation is a keyframe script player inside the UI, built on the URL view state in state.ts and the keymap in keys.ts, driven from a Slidev iframe with the existing video as fallback, and the rejected option is a JS eval endpoint in the engine because it would be unauthenticated remote code execution. Nothing is built yet; it is waiting on a go-ahead for four commits before the 1 Nov pitch and a choice between the finished build session and a transcript replayer.
